graph_model: GAGA official frozen victim checkpoint; validation only
sequence_method: Canonical current-graph nonself one-hop, Boolean two-hop; class-group averages plus masked center; clean cache allclose guard before model calls

numeric_gate.normalization: mean/std from original-train meta only; std floor .001
numeric_gate.loss: binary cross entropy of convex probability fusion, clamp1e-6

api_learning: zero shot; grounded English descriptions followed by structured alpha decisions; no weight fine-tuning or label demonstrations
interpretation: Technical selected validation pilot only; neither robust-defense nor LLM-superiority conclusion is presupposed.
